telegrams.body: THE MAIN TRANSMITTER IS UNDER REPAIR AND COMMUNICATION IS BEING MAINTAINED ON THE RESERVE SET THE RADIO OFFICER WILL LISTEN AGAIN AT 1230 AND RECORD THE MESSAGE AT SLOW SPEED PLEASE HOLD ALL NONURGENT TRAFFIC UNTIL WE CONFIRM THAT THE REPAIR IS COMPLETE
